findings.body: The spec permits `plant`, `gl_code`, and `month` in any combination, but this shared-key rule only defines keys based on `gl_code`/`leaf_key`, optionally combined with plant. A plant-only row has no such base cell, and rows grouped by month can repeat the same GL/plant key across months. Because `budgetStates` and client lookups are required to use this key, the core “Actual by plant” result can lack a defined budget-state key, while multi-month rows can receive another row's state and accessible label. Define keys for every allowed result grain, including plant alone and all month-bearing shapes.
findings.title: Define unique row keys for plant-only and month-grouped results
